$comment: Frozen, pre-existing audit failures. The ratchet.
An audit listed here may fail without breaking the build, but its failure
count can never grow. If the count rises, or a script not listed here
This exists so a real gate could be switched on today rather than after a
content project. Debt is frozen and visible, not hidden.
To retire an entry: fix the underlying problem, confirm the audit exits 0,
then delete the entry. Never raise a count to make a build pass.
